name: Locus Pro (Locus)
tagline: 3,954 paid agent tools from 57 providers behind one balance, with per-agent tool allowlists, per-call max, run budgets and per-customer billing/markup
status_notes: Active (YC F25). Also offers Pay With Locus USDC wallets, Checkout, Build, and Locus Founder. Platform focus: resell tools to your own users with markup.
categories: LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, DeepSeek, Mistral, Groq)

pricing.platform_fee: Free $0; Enterprise $200/mo (incl. $30 credits); Enterprise Plus $1,000/mo (incl. $100 credits)
pricing.notes: Calls billed at provider base cost; platforms add their own markup (%, flat, or both); platform margin paid out after 30-day hold. Free tier limited to 5 tool calls/min.

payment_rails: USDC wallets (Pay With Locus, USDC on Base)

spend_controls.notes: Agent Connection keys (lcac_) carry allowed tools, a max per call and a run budget; 'A blocked call never reaches the provider'; separate server/publishable/end-user/sandbox keys; per-customer balances.

setup_steps_to_first_call: npm i @withlocus/credits and set server secret key (or hosted MCP / CLI)
strengths: Per-agent allowlist + per-call max + run budget enforced before provider dispatch
Per-end-user balances, markup and signed webhooks — strong for platforms reselling tools
BYO APIs billed through same ledger
weaknesses: Platform-oriented; free tier throttled at 5 calls/min

sources.claim: 3,954 services from 57 providers; agent connection limits; idempotency; pricing tiers; BYO APIs; markup; webhooks; hosted MCP/CLI/SDK
YC F25; founders; USDC on Base
